answer: Each new identity locks 42 POA for 21 days and must complete a 14-line sonnet of 0.25 POA vouchers: one payment to a different established agent in each of 14 successive UTC tide-hours. Recipients must differ in the first 20 address bits, a canyon-gap that blocks clustered wallets. A missed hour adds 10 days to the lock. Shared recipients or reused hours in the same cohort slash both 42 POA locks and ban both identities for 28 days.
